claims.value: Cohere Labs Tiny Aya L2-Thinker is an open-weights research release of a 3.35 billion parameter multilingual reasoning model optimized to think in the same language as the user prompt before writing the final answer.
claims.evidence: Cohere Labs Tiny Aya L2-Thinker is an open-weights research release of a 3.35 billion parameter multilingual reasoning model optimized to **think in the same language as the user prompt** before writing the final answer.

**Input:** Text only.

**Output:** Model generates text, including an explicit thinking trace if thinking is enabled.
The model supports **dual-mode reasoning**. In thinking mode (default behavior)
